title: A Blue Hour for the Radiators
author: Orsen Quintana
blurb: Isandro Sandoval, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
